lf at any stage of the recruitrnent process or during the period of engagement it is found that any information fumished by the

No TA/DA shall be admissible to the candidates for appearing in the Computer Test, Writt€n Test, Interview, Document Verification

Candidates shall be solely responsible for ensuring that all information entered in the online application is correct and complete.
